title: Internal: Closing Business Savings Accounts
summary: This document explains pre-closure checks and the closure procedure for Closing Business Savings Accounts (Bronze Saver, Silver Saver, Gold Saver, Platinum Reserve). It specifies early-closure fees ($75/$125/$250/$500) tied to timeframes, required notice periods (10/14/21/30 days), and approval needs, plus that any early fee is deducted from the account balance only.
faqs: What must be verified before closing a business savings account (account status, pending transactions, linked checking, and balance vs early-closure fee)?
What early-closure fee and timeframe applies to the Bronze Saver account (and what notice period is required)?
What early-closure fee and timeframe applies to the Silver Saver and Gold Saver accounts (and their notice periods)?
What early-closure fee and timeframe applies to the Platinum Reserve account (and what notice period is required)?
When is supervisor review or manager approval required during the closure process?
What are the step-by-step instructions and system action to close the account (including use of close_bank_account_7392)?
